Leviticus 18:14 and 20:20 prohibit sexual relations with one's aunt (the father's brother's wife). The word derives from dod ('uncle, beloved') and marks female relatives in the paternal line. These laws reflect Israel's incest prohibitions, defining the degrees of kinship within which marriage and sexual relations were forbidden."
